title: Modelling and Calibration of Climate-Related Credit Risk Under the Emissions Trading System
abstract: arXiv:2611.34771v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Emission trading systems (ETSs) price a growing share of global emissions, and some of their caps are set to reach zero within the maturity of corporate debt. We develop a structural model in which firms choose their emissions from several energy sources under an anticipated carbon price, while the realized carbon price clears the carbon market of each sector-region cell, with a scenario-dependent demand shock and physical losses mitigated by adaptation. We show that the equilibrium carbon price exists, characterize when the cap binds, and derive the optimal emission of each firm in feedback form. In a linearized case of the model, the carbon price is deterministic, and the default probability is explicit. Unlike a reward-penalty scheme, the ETS imposes no cost while the cap is slack and makes firms meet it exactly once it binds. translated_title: 排放交易体系下气候相关信用风险的建模与校准
translated_abstract: 排放交易体系（ETS）正在为全球越来越多的排放量定价，其中一些排放上限将在企业债务到期期限内降至零。我们开发了一个结构化模型：企业在预期碳价下从多种能源来源中选择其排放量，而实际碳价则使每个“部门-区域”单元的碳市场出清，同时纳入情景相关的需求冲击以及通过适应性措施加以缓解的物理损失。我们证明了均衡碳价的存在性，刻画了排放上限何时具有约束力，并以反馈形式推导出每个企业的最优排放量。在模型的线性化情形下，碳价是确定性的，且违约概率具有显式表达式。与奖惩机制不同，排放交易体系在上限尚未约束时不施加任何成本，而一旦上限具有约束力，企业必须精确满足该上限。该模型在欧盟排放交易体系下对35家欧洲电力生产商进行了校准，再现了欧……（摘要原文截断）
tldr: 该论文构建了一个排放交易体系下气候相关信用风险的结构化模型，证明了均衡碳价的存在性并以反馈形式求解企业最优排放，在线性化情形下获得显式违约概率，并利用欧盟排放交易体系下35家欧洲电力生产商的数据进行了校准。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a structural model of climate-related credit risk under emissions trading systems, proving the existence of equilibrium carbon prices and deriving firms' optimal emissions in feedback form, with explicit default probabilities in the linearized case, calibrated to 35 European power producers under the EU ETS.
